**Download `lander-rewrite-windows-x64.zip` and unzip it.** Put your Lander disc image into the folder
*Put your Lander disc image here*, then double-click `Lander.exe`.

This release does not include the game: it plays from your own Lander CD image (`.cue`/`.bin` or
`.mds`/`.mdf` with the music, or `.iso`). See `How to play.txt` in the zip.
